Allah swears by the morning light.
And by the night when it is still and dark.
Your Lord has not left you, and He does not hate you.
And the next life is better for you than this one.
And your Lord will soon give you so much that you will be happy.
Did He not find you with no parents and give you a home?
And find you lost and show you the way?
And find you poor and give you enough?
So do not be hard on the child with no parents.
And do not shout at the one who asks for help.
And talk about the gifts of your Lord.
